direction: 明亮、自然的儿童教学英语，清楚但不逐字顿读。对话接话流畅，问句有语调变化；关键词轻重音自然。无背景音乐、夸张音效或故意含混的发音。

voices.child_f: 自然明亮的女孩角色声，不模仿真实儿童
voices.child_m: 自然轻快的男孩角色声，不模仿真实儿童

questions.title: Tom给妈妈的放学留言
questions.focus: 从情境中听懂动作，3图热身

parts.clue: new English book和read对应读书。

turns.text: Hi, Mum! I'm home. My new English book is here. I want to read it for a bit.

parts.clue: thirsty是口渴，have a drink对应喝水。

turns.text: Oh, I'm thirsty! There's some water on the table. Let me have a drink.

parts.clue: Dad在门口等，接着说一起去公园跑步。

turns.text: Dad is waiting by the door now. We're going to run in the park. See you later!

questions.title: Amy的周日小心愿
questions.focus: 用原因串起活动，3图换篇

parts.clue: messy和tidy my room说明先整理房间。

turns.text: Look at my room. What a mess! I'm going to tidy it before Mum gets home.

parts.clue: new paints和picture说明画画。

turns.text: My new paints are on the shelf. I want to make a picture for her, too. A big yellow cat!

parts.clue: 晚饭时跟爸爸学做饭。

turns.text: For dinner, Dad says I can help in the kitchen. Great! I'm going to learn to cook with him.

questions.title: 出门前，妈妈和Leo聊安排
questions.focus: 听问答衔接，4图，第一项示例

parts.clue: 妈妈问书包，Leo回答正在把书装进去。

turns.text: Leo, are your books in your school bag?
Not yet, Mum. I'm putting them in now.

parts.clue: 放学后和Sam踢足球。

turns.text: What are you going to do after school?
Play football with Sam. He's got a new ball!

parts.clue: 姐姐教歌，要跟她唱。

turns.text: My sister wants to teach me a song when I get home. I'm going to sing with her.
That sounds fun.

parts.clue: 妈妈提醒晚饭前整理房间，Leo同意。

turns.text: And your room? Please tidy it before dinner.
OK, Mum. I can do that.

questions.title: Mia给朋友介绍周末
questions.focus: 根据地点和物品理解活动，4图

parts.clue: pool和learn to swim对应游泳。

turns.text: Hi, Eva! My swimming lesson is on Saturday. I want to learn to swim, so Mum is taking me to the pool.

parts.clue: 周日帮妈妈做午餐。

turns.text: On Sunday, I'm going to help Mum cook lunch. I can wash the vegetables. What can you cook?

parts.clue: 下午拿画笔，给朋友画一幅画。

turns.text: In the afternoon, my paints are coming out! I want to paint a picture for you.

parts.clue: 周一要上学，睡前把书装好。

turns.text: School again on Monday! Before bed, I need to put my books in my school bag. Send me your plans!

parts.clue: Anna要少喝果汁、多喝水，目标活动是喝水。

turns.text: Anna, how do you want to stay healthy?
Less juice and more water! I'm going to take my water bottle to school.

parts.clue: 新俱乐部是游泳俱乐部。

turns.text: Are you joining a new club?
Yes, the swimming club. My first lesson is on Wednesday.

parts.clue: 否定看电视，肯定饭后读英语。看电视不在图片选项中。

turns.text: And after dinner? More TV?
No! I'm going to read English. Just a little every evening.

parts.clue: 奶奶周六教她做饭。

turns.text: I want to help at home, too. Grandma is going to teach me to cook on Saturday.
Lovely!

parts.clue: 最后提到结交新朋友。

turns.text: Anything else?
I'd like some new friends at my club. I'm going to say hello to someone new.

parts.clue: 看到地上的书，提醒自己整理房间。

turns.text: My books are on the floor again. Come on, Ben! I want to be tidy. My room needs some work.

parts.clue: 找出足球鞋，加入足球队。

turns.text: Here's my football shoe! I need it for the school team. We're going to play after school.

parts.clue: 晚饭后读新故事书。

turns.text: There's my new storybook, too. I want to read it after dinner. It looks really good.

parts.clue: 运动后喝水。

turns.text: And I must remember my water bottle. More water after exercise, Ben!

parts.clue: 最后提到音乐俱乐部里唱歌。

turns.text: One more thing. The music club starts on Friday. I'm going to sing there. I hope I can remember the words!

questions.title: Lucy的周六小冒险
questions.focus: 通过事件衔接排序，6图模拟

parts.clue: 阳台植物需要水，Lucy负责浇水。

turns.text: It's Saturday. The plants outside need water. Lucy picks up a little can and gives them a drink.

parts.clue: 吃早饭前读英语。

turns.text: Breakfast isn't ready yet. She opens her English book. A little reading is a good start to the day.

parts.clue: 爸爸喊她出门，一起跑步。

turns.text: Dad calls her from the door. They are going to run in the park. Lucy puts on her shoes and joins him.

parts.clue: 午饭后把公园画下来。

turns.text: Back home after lunch, Lucy wants to paint the park. She adds a big tree and two little birds.

parts.clue: 画完口渴，喝了一杯水。

turns.text: That takes a long time. I'm thirsty now, she says. A glass of water is just what she needs.

parts.clue: 画笔和书散开了，最后整理房间。

turns.text: Paints and books are everywhere! Before bed, Lucy tidies her room. Now she's ready for another busy day.

questions.title: 班级广播：我们的新目标
questions.focus: 不同表达对应图片，6图模拟

parts.clue: Amy要在新学校结交朋友。

turns.text: Welcome to our class radio! Amy is new here. Her goal is to make new friends. Say hello to her today!

parts.clue: Tom帮家人做饭。

turns.text: Tom wants to help his family. He's learning to cook with his dad. What's for dinner, Tom?

parts.clue: Ben练篮球，不是被否定的足球。

turns.text: Ben loves ball games. Not football this time. He's going to practise basketball every day.

parts.clue: Mia在公园跑步。

turns.text: Mia wants to get stronger. You can find her running in the park after school. Good luck, Mia!

parts.clue: Leo的新画笔用于画画。

turns.text: Leo has some new paints. He wants to learn to paint animals. His first picture is a very funny cat.

parts.clue: Eva睡前装书包。

turns.text: And Eva? No more missing books! She's going to pack her school bag before bed. That's all for today.

questions.title: 主持人聊本周计划
questions.format: 主持人与学生轮流接话
questions.focus: 按介绍顺序，防止按星期排序，6图

parts.clue: 先介绍Ben的篮球，比赛改到周五，不改变图片排序。

turns.text: Ben, is your basketball game on Thursday?
No, Friday! We're going to play after school.

parts.clue: 接着Amy介绍周一唱歌。

turns.text: Amy, what about you?
I'm going to sing at the music club on Monday. I'm a little excited!

parts.clue: 主持人再介绍Leo周三到图书馆读英语。

turns.text: Leo can't be here today. His plan is to read English at the library on Wednesday.

parts.clue: Mia周六游泳。

turns.text: Mia, any plans for Saturday?
The pool! I'm going to swim with Dad.

parts.clue: Tom去新学校，想结交朋友。

turns.text: Tom is starting at a new school. He wants to make some new friends.

parts.clue: 最后Eva说周日整理房间，不能自行把周日放到别的位置。

turns.text: And finally, Eva?
My room is a mess. Sunday morning is my tidy-up time!

questions.title: 老师带来的六条好消息
questions.format: 老师给家长的语音周报
questions.focus: 从自然叙述中抓行动，6图换篇

parts.clue: Anna的目标是多读英语书。

turns.text: Hello, everyone. Our class has some lovely new goals. Anna wants to read more English books. She's starting a new one on Thursday.

parts.clue: Ben每天带水，目标是多喝水。

turns.text: Ben brings his water bottle every day now. Less juice, more water. That's his idea for staying healthy.

parts.clue: Tom周二跟爸爸做饭。

turns.text: Tom is going to learn to cook with his dad on Tuesday. He says he wants to make dinner for the family.

parts.clue: Leo周五参加俱乐部，想交朋友。

turns.text: Our new pupil Leo is joining a club on Friday. He hopes to make some friends there.

parts.clue: Mia游泳课改到周三；按广播中介绍顺序排图。

turns.text: Mia's swimming lesson has a new time. Wednesday afternoon. She's going to the pool with her mum.

parts.clue: 最后Eva每天饭后整理房间。

turns.text: And Eva wants to keep her room tidy. A little work after dinner each day. Small steps can make a big difference!
